title: Waat bu judduwul
intro: Ruuh bu dëggu dafa def dige bu sell balaa xale di ñëw. Jaar-jaaru nit ki mingi am ci biir miiru barab bu sell, di barab bu jaamu Yàlla daje ak nangug Yàlla. Kan mooy jaamu Yàlla bii?
clues: Maa ngi bokk ci famiy bu Al Quran sargal.
Maa ngi ni dinaa jox sama doom jiy judd ngir liggéeyal ko Yàlla.
Bima juddoo, dama yéemu bima gisee ni doom ju jigéen la, doonte maa ngi doon seentu doom ju góor.
Ma tuddee sama doom Maryam, muy tur wuy wane njub ak jaamu Yàlla.
Maa ngi ñaan Yàlla mu aar sama doom ak ay doomam ci Seytaane bu alku bi.
Boroom bi nangu na sama doom, mu bàyyi ko ci loxo Yonent Zakariya ci barab bu sell bi.

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Waat ni dina jox doomam jaamukaay bi
Jéggi géej gi ci kaw suuf su wow
trial.answer: Waat ni dina jox doomam jaamukaay bi

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Barab bu sell bi (mihrab) ñu defoon doomam
Date palme bimu noppalu ci suufa suuf
location.answer: Barab bu sell bi (mihrab) ñu defoon doomam

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Doomam nangu nañu ko, bàyyi ko ci loxo Yonent-Yàlla Zakariya
Dañu ko muccal ci yar bu jaay doole
Mu am doom bu góor bu tuddu Yahya
Taw bu metti yàq na askanam
Nekk na reine ci nguur gu mag
outcome.answer: Doomam nangu nañu ko, bàyyi ko ci loxo Yonent-Yàlla Zakariya

arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًۭا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verse: [Mention, O Muḥammad], when the wife of ʿImrān said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing." (3:35)
